Imagine if you could make your own dinner just by standing outside in the sunshine. That is basically what plants do! Since plants can’t go to the grocery store, they use a process called **photosynthesis** to turn sunlight into food. They act like tiny solar-powered factories, using energy from the sun to mix together ingredients they find in the world around them.
